sentences.japanese: 君が職に就けるといいんだが。
sentences.english: I should be glad if you got the job.

sentences.japanese: 宇宙科学はまだその緒に就いたばかりである。
sentences.english: Space science is still in its infancy.

sentences.japanese: 医者達は彼が死んだと思いましたが、今日彼はまだ生きており、健康で、仕事にも就いて家族もいます。
sentences.english: The doctors thought he was dead, but today he is still alive and healthy, and has a job and a family.

sentences.japanese: 悪い人間が国家の要職に就いていますね。
sentences.english: Bad people are at the helm of the nation.
